attchmntText: GAIL (India) Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 12, 2026, titled "Signing of MoU by GAIL (India) Limited & Krishak Bharati Cooperative Limited with Andhra Pradesh Economic Development Board for exploring the opportunity to setup a gas-based fertilizer project in the State of Andhra Pradesh".
voiceSummary: GAIL India Limited and Krishak Bharati Cooperative Limited signed a Memorandum of Understanding with the Andhra Pradesh Economic Development Board on November 12, 2026. The agreement explores establishing a gas-based urea plant in Andhra Pradesh. The facility is planned for Mulapeta in the Srikakulam district. It will have a capacity of 1.27 Million Metric Tons Per Annum. The project will be located along GAIL’s Srikakulam Angul Natural Gas Pipeline. The MoU was signed during the 31st CII Partnership Summit 2026 in Visakhapatnam. Officials from all three entities signed the document. The Chief Minister of Andhra Pradesh was present at the ceremony. This announcement serves as a press release filed with the National Stock Exchange and BSE Limited.

voiceSummary: Prakash Pipes Limited filed a press release regarding financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September, 2026. Net sales for the quarter reached Rs. 259 crores, up 43% year-on-year. EBITDA was Rs. 28 crores, a 70% increase. Profit after Tax stood at Rs. 16 crores, up 72%. For the half year, net sales were Rs. 501 crores, up 30%. EBITDA was Rs. 55 crores, up 58%. Profit after Tax was Rs. 33 crores, up 65%. Earnings per share for the half year were Rs. 13.59. The PVC Pipes and Fittings division recorded sales volume of 10,773 MT. The Flexible Packaging division achieved sales volume of 5,549 MT, a 38% growth. The company noted resin price stabilization but warned of geopolitical impacts. Expansion in production capacity is underway for the Flexible Packaging division.

The company reported total income of INR342.7 crores, a 15.6% year-on-year increase. Consolidated EBITDA rose 12% to INR123.8 crores with a margin of 36.1%. Excluding INR10 crores from GST regulation changes, comparable EBITDA grew 21.3% to INR133.8 crores. Profit after tax stood at INR41.1 crores. Net debt was INR1458 crores as of September 2026. The company highlighted a secured pipeline adding 1,670 rooms and rebranding 473 rooms. Key projects include a W Hotel in Hyderabad and a Westin in Bangalore. Management expects net debt to reduce to 2.5x by the end of the fiscal year. Same-store revenue grew 12.6%, and occupancy reached 78.6%.

attchmntText: All Time Plastics Limited has informed the Exchange about Transcript
voiceSummary: All Time Plastics Limited reported Q2 FY27 revenue of INR174 crores, an 18% year-on-year increase. Gross margin declined to 34.3% from 36.2% in Q2 FY26 due to a 40% to 45% rise in polymer prices and delayed price pass-through. EBITDA margin fell to 7.9% from 11% in the prior year quarter. Profit after tax stood at INR4.2 crores. H1 FY27 revenue grew 9.7% to INR335.1 crores. Polymer processing volumes reached 6,910 metric tons in Q2. The company maintains a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.15. New capacity additions are expected in December 2026. Bamboo facility production is scheduled to commence in mid-November 2026. Domestic revenue grew 36% sequentially. The company targets 15% to 20% revenue growth for FY27.

attchmntText: VIP Industries Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 12, 2026, titled "VIP Industries Delivers 15% Revenue Growth in Q2, Led by Successful New Product Launches.".
voiceSummary: VIP Industries Limited filed a press release regarding its financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. The Board of Directors approved the consolidated income from operations, which rose 15% year-on-year to Rs 468 crore, compared to Rs 406 crore in the corresponding quarter of the previous year. The company reported an EBITDA loss of Rs 27 crore, narrowing from Rs 96 crore in Q2 FY26. Gross margin improved sequentially from 39% in Q1 FY27 to 44% in Q2 FY27. The company targets sustained double-digit growth and aims for break-even.

attchmntText: Turtlemint Fintech Solutions Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 12, 2026, titled "Press Release on Unaudited Financial Results (Standalone and Consolidated) of the Company for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026"
voiceSummary: Turtlemint Fintech Solutions Limited filed a press release with BSE and NSE regarding its unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. Platform premium grew 55% year-on-year to INR 1,214 crore in Q2 FY27. Revenue from operations increased 35% to INR 342 crore. Service EBITDA rose 47% to INR 45 crore. Adjusted EBITDA as a percentage of revenue improved from minus 14% to minus 6%. Corporate overheads as a percentage of revenue declined from 26% to 19%. attchmntText: Update on Acquisition of Equity Shares of Aerolex Cables Private Limited by Aeroflex Neu Limited, the material subsidiary of the Company

attchmntText: Gulshan Polyols Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
voiceSummary: Gulshan Polyols Limited filed an investor presentation regarding its unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. For Q2 FY27, the company reported income of Rs. 542 Cr, a 13% year-on-year increase, with profit after tax at Rs. 15.5 Cr and EBITDA at Rs. 42 Cr. For H1 FY27, income stood at Rs. 1,137 Cr, with PAT at Rs. 29 Cr and EBITDA at Rs. 81 Cr. attchmntText: Bharat Forge Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Approval of Resolution Plan for Tork Motors Private Limited'.
voiceSummary: Bharat Forge Limited informs that the National Company Law Tribunal, Mumbai Bench-II, approved the Resolution Plan for Tork Motors Private Limited, a step-down subsidiary, under Section 31 of the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code, 2016. The order was dated November 6, 2026, and received by the Company on November 12, 2026. Kalyani Powertrain Limited, a wholly owned subsidiary, holds 64.29% of Tork's equity share capital. The approved Resolution Plan provides for the extinguishment of Tork's existing equity share capital and a consequential change in its ownership and management. Upon implementation, Tork will cease to be a step-down subsidiary of Bharat Forge Limited. The Company will make further disclosures as required on the implementation of the Resolution Plan or any material developments.

attchmntText: Mstc Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
voiceSummary: MSTC Limited announced unaudited financial results for the half year ended 30 September 2026. Standalone EBITDA rose to INR 184.55 crore from INR 130.71 crore. Standalone PBT reached INR 178.06 crore, and PAT was INR 132.72 crore. Consolidated PAT stood at INR 133.13 crore. The company transacted goods worth INR 545.80 billion through its e-commerce vertical. MSTC exited its legacy Trading business. Key transactions included selling liquor shop licenses in Karnataka for approximately INR 125 crore, selling land in Hyderabad valued at INR 2863 crore, and selling an Oil Rig for USD 5,808,251.00. The company launched Round 6 of UDAN and Tranche VIII auction of Critical Mineral Blocks. MSTC is examining feasibility for Coal and Mineral exchanges, upgrading its B2C travel portal, and developing a TReDS platform. A conference call with investors is scheduled for 13 November 2026 at 11:00 am IST.

attchmntText: Brooks Laboratories Limited has informed the Exchange about Credit Rating- Revision
voiceSummary: Brooks Laboratories Limited has received an upgrade in its credit ratings from CARE Ratings Limited. The long-term bank facilities rating is upgraded to CARE BB plus with a stable outlook, from CARE BB. The short-term bank facilities rating is upgraded to CARE A4 plus, from CARE A4. The upgrade follows the receipt of Rs. 106.33 crore from the partial divestment of its stake in Brooks Steriscience Limited. This capital infusion strengthens the company's liquidity and financial risk profile. Contingent liabilities have reduced to approximately Rs. 48.15 crore. Profit before interest, lease rentals, depreciation and taxation margin improved to 8.88 percent in FY26. The company plans to use the funds for capital expenditure. A proposed demerger of the manufacturing business into Abridge Speciality Limited is also noted.

voiceSummary: JBF Industries Limited, under Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process, filed un-audited financial results for the quarter ended 30 September 2026. Earnings per share stood at negative Rs. 0.09 for the quarter. Independent auditor S.C. Ajmera & Co. issued a qualified opinion. The qualification cites non-provision of interest aggregating Rs. 2,47,379 lakhs on term loans and cash credit limits. The auditor also noted uncertainty regarding a Rs. 12,848 lakhs claim by an operational creditor of subsidiary JBF RAK LLC. An emphasis of matter highlights the company's cessation as a going concern. voiceSummary: Jana Small Finance Bank Limited intimates that it received an order dated November 3, 2026, from the National Company Law Tribunal, Chennai Bench, on November 11, 2026. attchmntText: Campus Activewear Limited has informed the Exchange about Transcript
voiceSummary: Campus Activewear Limited filed a transcript of its Q2 and H1 FY’27 earnings conference call held on 05th November 2026. The company reported revenue growth of 16.9% year-on-year to Rs. 452 crores, driven by a 10.2% volume increase to 6.3 million pairs and a 6% rise in average selling price. The profit before tax margin declined to 9.02 percent from 25.78 percent. Revenue stood at 3,222.17 lakhs. attchmntText: LTM Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 12, 2026, titled "LTM Brings AI-Powered Quantum Error Mitigation to IBM Quantum Functions Catalog".
voiceSummary: LTM Limited submitted a press release to the National Stock Exchange of India Limited and BSE Limited on November 12, 2026. The release announces that LTM's proprietary AI-powered Quantum Error Mitigation capability, named AI-QEM, is now available in the IBM Quantum Functions Catalog. LTM states it is the first Global Systems Integrator worldwide to publish a function in this catalog. The AI-QEM function allows users to apply error mitigation directly within Qiskit workflows. It uses advanced AI models to correct device-specific error patterns through classical post-processing. This method supports improved result accuracy without additional quantum processing unit time or extra qubits. The capability has been validated on IBM Quantum computers across experiments involving more than 100 qubits.

The agreement outlines a proposed long-term supply of up to 40,000 tonnes of synthetic graphite-based Anode Active Material for electric mobility applications. The arrangement is subject to further discussions and finalization of technical and commercial requirements. The collaboration also includes research and custom development of next-generation fast-charging and high-range battery materials. TACC Limited is currently developing production capabilities for anode active material and graphene. This announcement was made pursuant to SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015.

attchmntText: Adani Enterprises Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 12, 2026, titled "Intimation for submission of Media Release for the subject Adani s Kutch Copper and Chile s Codelco Sign Strategic MoU for exploration of Kaburkaala project in Chile".
voiceSummary: Adani Enterprises Limited submitted a media release regarding its subsidiary Kutch Copper Ltd and Chile’s Codelco signing a strategic Memorandum of Understanding for the exploration of the Kaburkaala copper project in Chile. The agreement aims to link Chilean copper resources with Adani’s integrated copper smelter complex at Mundra, India. The MoU was signed in London during LME Week 2026. This partnership involves capital, technology-led exploration, and project execution capabilities from Adani, combined with Codelco’s geological knowledge. The collaboration supports India’s resource security and Codelco’s strategy to create value from its exploration portfolio through public-private partnerships.

attchmntText: Waaree Energies Limited has informed the Exchange about Clarification on the news article published by Moneycontrol on November 11, 2026 titled "Waaree admitted misreporting solar import origin in submission to US trade commission"
voiceSummary: Waaree Energies Ltd. issued a clarification regarding a Moneycontrol article dated November 11, 2026. The company stated that the US International Trade Commission investigation covers the Indian solar industry as a whole and is not a case against Waaree. No finding, penalty, or liability was assessed separately against the company. The article referenced past shipments where modules were declared Indian-origin, while US Customs used cell origin for duty purposes. This matter was previously disclosed on June 28, 2026. US Customs and Border Protection confirmed Waaree did not ship modules made with Chinese cells and limited duty liability to a small set of past shipments. No new financial or operational impact resulted from the findings. Possible exposure to anti-dumping and countervailing duties is already reflected in financial statements disclosed on November 2, 2026. The order book rationalization mentioned in the article was disclosed with results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. The company is evaluating a challenge to the US Customs decision before the US Court of International Trade.

attchmntText: Neueon Corporation Limited has informed the Exchange regarding the Amendment to AOA/MOA of the company.
voiceSummary: Neueon Corporation Limited has informed the stock exchanges that its members approved alterations to the Articles of Association via Special Resolution through postal ballot on Thursday 29th October 2026. voiceSummary: Power Grid Corporation of India Limited has been declared the successful bidder under Tariff Based Competitive Bidding to establish an Intra-State Transmission System. The board approved the unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. Managing Director Subhrakant Panda reported higher performance due to capacity additions and better prices. The KNR-2 unit reached 84,000 tons per annum production, with full capacity expected by December 2026. The KNR-1 unit achieved hot metal tapping on 25th August 2026, with the second furnace expected around 15th November 2026. The company approved a capex of INR375 crores to increase chrome ore output and produce low-carbon ferro chrome. Volume guidance for FY27 remains at 380,000 tons, and FY28 at 475,000 tons. The company clarified it has no updates on critical minerals auctions.

desc: Pendency of Litigation(s)/dispute(s) or the outcome impacting the Company
voiceSummary: DCW Limited filed an update on pending litigation regarding Writ Appeal WA(MD) 1436/2025, where the Government of Tamil Nadu challenged a Madras High Court Madurai Bench order dated February 26, 2024. The High Court dismissed the appeal on November 03, 2026, ruling that the government could not resume the lands and that the company would suffer detriment if the promise to allot land was broken. The court held that the ingredients of proprietary estoppel were fulfilled and found no merit in the government's claim. The order was uploaded to the court website on November 10, 2026. The company disclosed this information on November 11, 2026, citing a delay due to the Diwali holiday on November 10, 2026, and the time required to review the order. The company remains in possession of the lands pending final disposal.

It also allows for the reduction of manganese ore Run of Mine capacity from 1.34 Million Tonnes Per Annum to 0.7330 Million Tonnes Per Annum. The company received the Veramark Assurance certification. This certification was formerly known as Copper Mark. Kutch Copper Limited is the first Indian producer to receive this recognition. The framework promotes responsible copper production. It involves independent third-party audits of environmental, social, and governance performance. The certification aligns with United Nations Sustainable Development Goals. Specifically, it supports goal twelve on responsible consumption and production. The announcement was made on November 11, 2026. Dr. Vinay Prakash is the Managing Director of Kutch Copper Limited. He stated the milestone positions the company among leading global producers. The collaboration operates within India's regulatory and data protection frameworks.

voiceSummary: Intellect Design Arena Limited announces the launch of Xponent Portfolio Navigator by its Insurtech unit, IntellectAI. Consolidated sales volume grew 13% year-on-year to 24,501 tons, with revenue rising 31% to INR309.6 crores. Consolidated EBITDA recovered to INR11.5 crores, representing a 3.7% margin. The company entered the ceramic tiles segment through the acquisition of Mazzini Tiles. Management targets expanding capacity to 2,88,000 tons within two years, funded by internal cash flow. Apollo Pipes standalone EBITDA margin stood at 5.7%. The company aims to reach an EBITDA per ton of INR9,000 to INR10,000 for Apollo standalone in the second half of FY27. Kisan is targeted to reach breakeven in the next six months.

attchmntText: Jyoti Structures Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 11, 2026, titled ""Jyoti Structures Limited Aims for a Larger Order Book with the Availability of Bank Guarantees/Letters of Credit from Lenders."".
voiceSummary: Jyoti Structures Limited announces the progressive release of bank guarantees and letters of credit by its lenders. This action follows the NCLT approved resolution plan under the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code, 2016, and the NCLAT order dated 26 May 2026. After a five-year delay, lenders are disbursing facilities from the INR 510.59 crores envisaged in the plan. These facilities are being made available in line with current business requirements. The prior non-availability of these instruments limited the company's ability to execute its order book. Their release strengthens the operational platform and supports the execution of the growing order book. The company aims to pursue new opportunities in the power transmission and infrastructure sectors. The press release was issued on November 11, 2026.

attchmntText: JSW Steel Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 11, 2026, titled "JSW Steel reports Consolidated Crude Steel Production of  25.73 Lakh Tonnes for October 2026"
voiceSummary: JSW Steel reported consolidated crude steel production of 25.73 Lakh Tonnes for October 2026, representing a 19% year-on-year growth. Indian operations contributed 24.86 Lakh Tonnes, while JSW Steel USA Ohio contributed 0.87 Lakh Tonnes. Capacity utilization for Indian operations was 92%. Previous year figures have been adjusted to exclude the Bhushan Power and Steel Limited steel business undertaking transferred to JSW-JFE Steel Limited in March 2026. The company is the flagship business of the JSW Group and aims to expand its combined crude steel capacity to 54.8 MTPA over the next four years.

attchmntText: HEG Advanced Materials Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 11, 2026, titled "TACC Receives Approval Letter for Rs 609.50 Crore Incentive under ECMS for its Synthetic Graphite Anode Material Project in Dewas".
voiceSummary: HEG Advanced Materials Limited disclosed that its wholly owned subsidiary, TACC Limited, received an approval letter for an incentive of Rs 609.50 crore under the Electronics Component Manufacturing Scheme. The incentive supports TACC’s Synthetic Graphite Anode Material project in Dewas, Madhya Pradesh. The facility spans over 100 acres and targets a phase one capacity of 20,000 tonnes per annum by June 2027. The project aims for a total committed capacity beyond 30,000 metric tonnes per annum by FY2028-29. The approval is subject to scheme guidelines and prescribed conditions.

sm_name: Krishna Institute of Medical Sciences Limited
voiceSummary: Krishna Institute of Medical Sciences Limited filed a transcript of its Q2 FY2027 earnings conference call held on 5th November 2026. The company reported consolidated revenue of INR1,363 crores, an EBITDA of INR279 crores, and a PAT of INR76 crores. Operational highlights included IP volumes of 81,668 and OP volumes of 731,010. Management discussed acquisitions in Kakinada, Sangli, Secunderabad, and Guntur, along with operations management agreements in Hyderabad and Thrissur. The call addressed the impact of trade margin rationalization on anti-cancer drugs, noting final details were pending disclosure on 9th November. Management also commented on the ramp-up of the Kondapur unit, margin normalization in the Andhra Pradesh cluster due to new oncology programs, and a one-time INR8 crores provision for doubtful debts related to government business.
